# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what was changed, why it was changed (mention any relevant issues), and how it was tested.

## Validation

- [ ] This change is sufficiently small (if not, please break into multiple/stacked PRs)
- [ ] Documentation updated as needed
- [ ] Tests added/updated as needed and passing
- [ ] `R CMD build` and `R CMD check` (local and/or CI)
- [ ] `BiocCheck` passes
- [ ] All lines of code reviewed by submitter

## Notes

Where should the reviewer start? What should they focus on? Was anything intentionally left out? Add any additional reviewer guidance, caveats, or follow-ups.

## Master Release Checklist

If this PR targets `master`/`main`, use the `master-release.md` template and complete every checklist item.
